With the new gating, new kids no longer download land_map at all (0 B in the s01 after-run), so moving it saves nothing for them. risks: The first Boss fight in a page now runs the engine when the kid taps 挑战BOSS or when startBoss runs. That is about 0.3–0.6 s of main thread at 4× CPU, read from the HTTP cache via the prefetch. If a counterattack comes first, it waits for the engine through the existing HansenBossAttack placeholder. Sprites start loading at the same moment, so on a slow phone the very first weapon image could still be late (the BUG#67 blank-weapon pattern).
The map glow is now a second copy of icons/map_home.webp with a static drop-shadow on top of the image. If the image fails to load, the existing emoji fallback appears without the glow.
Flyer bobbing now uses the CSS `translate` property (Chrome 104+ / iOS 14.1+). Older engines ignore it: the flyers still fly but stop bobbing.
Behaviour change for iOS and unknown networks (no navigator.connection): no idle island prefetch and no 星海 room warm. This matches HansenPreloadPolicy; touch prefetch still works.

During the 72 h free pass, after the wall has been opened once, every island open preloads all 20 portraits ("unlocked + next" is 20 then). This matches what the wall shows. Whether those are cache hits depends on the CDN's cache headers.
kidHasPlayed() JSON-parses the hsn_progress snapshots and, if needed, the wordIsland* saves once per page load.

Whether navigator.userActivation works inside WeChat (Android and iOS), so the engine starts loading when the wall opens. The fallback is startBoss.

Whether the CloudBase CDN sends cache headers. This decides whether preloading portraits after the wall was seen, and the engine prefetch, are cache hits or re-downloads.

deferred: Per-answer main-thread cost (already there before; this batch makes it worse). Every answer re-reads the whole ledger many times (readStore parses main + backup and merges them). markAnswer measured about 100–200 ms unthrottled for a kid with heavy progress on this loaded machine, and about 350–410 ms at 4× CPU throttling, on both origin/main and the worktree. The profile is dominated by readStore, mergeCurrentWithPrevious and compactStore. The batch's absorber adds about 3 readStores per miss. Suggested fix: cache the parsed ledger for the duration of one markAnswer call. Not done: it is deep in the persistence layer.

CLOZE_LEVEL_IDX includes words that can never be asked (animal easy: pig, eagle, cow; hard: duck; their example sentences use the plural). clozeTotal still counts them, so a perfect animal-easy round shows 10/13 = 77%. Already there before this batch; I only made sure the re-ask still happens.

Boss: the lesson card appears 1.1 s after a wrong answer, while the counterattack is still playing. The hit lands at 1.7–6.3 s depending on the boss (dealDelay). The card stays readable above the effects, but the hit plays behind it. At Lv20 one wrong answer can lose the fight, and the card then shows over the defeat page. This is a design choice for Hansen; it is not broken.
hansen_mistake_lesson_v1165.js is still not in the sw_v944 shell precache. That is a release step. Offline, the games fall back to the old timed advance without a card.

The batch's own 'found, not fixed' items still stand: the v1034 achievement ladder never unlocks; 听音 on land3 and land5 has 0 words and crashes; HansenMyLearning only exports `_open`; SVG text labels in vocab_all reach the PK battle (battle files are off-limits); opening the settings page still loads the 1.23 MB engine plus attack sprites.
Two 单词大陆/星海 pages open at the same time in two tabs could still overwrite each other. My fix covers a page's own outdated save when it opens.
risks: Product-policy change for Hansen to confirm: words missed in a round now stay in the 错题本 after a correct re-ask, and the home banner and 复习 badge show them as due today. If he wants the re-ask to clear the word, the +2 纠错金 incentive problem (a deliberate miss pays more than a right answer) has to be solved some other way.
There is now a 160 ms pause between tapping the lesson card and the next question, so that 一键静音 holds. It is small but noticeable to a fast tapper.

New cross-module contract: the templates' load() sets `window.__hsnLoadedSaveTime`, and the ledger relies on it during its first migrate and to block early absorbs. Pages that load S from a save without setting it fall back to the old behaviour. The full ledger, backup, reset and explore test set passes.

In 完形, a wrong answer now holds the card until the sentence finishes plus 0.8 s (cap 8 s), as the old wrong path did. If a phone's speech callback never fires, each 完形 miss waits up to 8 s unless the kid taps.
All timing observations come from a shared machine whose load average ranged from about 1 to 12. Pass/fail results are deterministic, but none of the ms figures should be quoted as phone performance.
